hard_deny: Never run git push, or any command that pushes commits to a remote repository, without the user's explicit real-time confirmation for that specific push.
Never delete, remove, or truncate files (rm, del, Remove-Item, rmdir, git rm, git clean, find -delete, etc.) without the user's explicit real-time confirmation for that specific deletion.

Never run a database CLI (psql, mysql, mongosh, sqlcmd, sqlite3, redis-cli) or apply/mutate a database migration (flyway migrate/clean/repair/undo/baseline, liquibase update/rollback/dropAll). Database changes are performed by the user, never by Claude.
